title: Test commit reachability
responsibility: Check whether a commit is the tip itself or an ancestor of it.

inputs.name: githubReaches.client
inputs.description: Repository transport for access validation and GitHub comparison.

inputs.name: githubReaches.input
inputs.description: Exact lowercase 40-character hex tip and candidate commit SHAs.

outputs.name: githubReaches
outputs.description: True for identical SHAs or a confirmed ancestor; false for a missing comparison or a nonancestor.
